claim: A parallax sky drawn in several panels needs the map header's sky bits and offsets: E1M5 wears tile 3678 with sky_bits 4 and offsets 0 to 15, sixteen panels round. A map that sets the tile with offsets left at zero repeats the first panel, and it draws as broken bands.
evidence: E1M5 s392 and its other open sectors wear 3678 as a parallax ceiling; read_map(E1M5).header sky_bits 4, sky_offsets 0..15
E4L1 pass 01 set 3678 alone and drew bands; pass 02 took E1M5's bits and offsets and drew the sky (evidence/pass-03 frames)
use: Copy the sky bits and offsets of a campaign map that wears the same sky.
